item.title: Murph starts the companion conversation
item.summary: After finishing account setup in the companion app with a verified phone, Murph can now start the conversation with the standard first iMessage.
item.details: When a healthy line is available, Murph sends the usual welcome and may keep unfinished setup moving with a low-pressure check-in on the next few days. If no line can safely start the conversation, setup still completes and you can text Murph first.
